text: Watch out if you hear these phrases from a woman. Men often say, you know, everything was fine, and then suddenly she did this. But very rarely is anything sudden. Usually the signs were there. You just ignored them. So here are four phrases that if you heard them from a woman, be careful, be extremely attentive, because chances are nothing good is waiting for you in that story with her. Number one, I am still not over my past relationship. This one sounds honest, even vulnerable, but think carefully. If she's not over her ex, then emotionally she's still attached. That means one of two things. Either she's still hoping for closure, or she's still hoping for him. And you don't want to be the rebound. You don't wanna be the emotional bandage while she processes another man. Number two, what can you offer me as a man? This question immediately puts you in a position where you have to prove yourself. You need to understand something clearly. No matter what you bring to the table, no matter how capable or impressive you actually are, the moment you start trying to prove your value in response to that question, you've already put yourself in a weaker position. A woman who frames the interaction like that will never truly respect or value you. And at the first opportunity, she will leave for someone she perceives as better. Number three, all my exes were toxic and treated me badly. If all her exes were abusive, toxic, didn't treat her well, you need to realize two things. First, she chose all of them. And second, even more important, she stayed with them even after she realized what kind of people they were. So at the very least, she is used to emotional roller coasters. She's used to drama. And when a woman is used to this type of love, a normal, stable relationship can feel like not enough. Number four, you have to prove you deserve it. If a woman says you have to earn basic affection, attention, or respect, she is conditioning you. It becomes reward-based interaction. You behave well, you get validation. You step out of line, it is withdrawn. That's not attraction, that is training. A relationship is not something you beg for or earn like a dog earning treats. These were four phrases. If you hear them from a woman, watch out. What other red flag or toxic phrases have you heard from women? Write them in the comments.
